description: Retire .agro/tasks/<slug>/evidence.md into the PR body, probe the task-folder artifact contract, and separate a tooling-blocked gate from a failed gate.

userStories.title: Move the evidence contract into the PR body
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the implementation's answer to the plan in the PR description, so that I never have to open a gitignored folder or discover the file was silently omitted.
acceptanceCriteria: `execute.md` step 7 writes the five questions into the PR body, in order, instead of a file
Step 10's evidence gate verifies the body carries them and refuses the undraft when it does not
The `git ls-files --error-unmatch` check and the `git add -f` of evidence.md are gone
`diverged` and `unverified` are still written `None`/`Nothing` explicitly rather than omitted
`grep -c 'evidence\.md' .agro/skills/spec/references/execute.md` returns 0

userStories.title: Sweep the remaining references
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want no skill telling a reader to write a file the workflow no longer produces.
acceptanceCriteria: The 11 referencing files under .agro/skills/ are updated
reviewer-evidence-doc.md becomes the PR-body contract rather than a file contract
`grep -rln 'evidence\.md' .agro/skills/` returns only past-tense descriptions of the retirement

userStories.title: Update the four probes that pin the artifact
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the probes guarding the evidence gate to assert the contract that now exists.
acceptanceCriteria: spec-ready-finalization.sh, spec-single-owner.sh, protected-path-deletion.sh and docs-20260901-followup-artifact-cited.sh each exit 0
Each asserts the PR-body contract, not a file path
No probe was weakened to pass

userStories.title: Probe the task-folder artifact contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a skipped gate to fail the suite, because absence is not an oracle.
acceptanceCriteria: Add .agro/evals/probes/spec-task-artifact-contract.sh, tier A, with the machine-read header and BASH_SOURCE root resolution
It derives the required artifact set from execute.md and asserts a completed task folder carries it
Exits 0 on this tree; exits 1 with REGRESSION when a required artifact is removed
The injected fault is diff-confirmed before the red result is trusted

userStories.title: Distinguish a gate that cannot run from a gate that failed
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a tooling gap reported as a tooling gap, so that I do not read it as a defect in my PR.
acceptanceCriteria: pr-acquire.sh detects an unsupported gh field and emits a distinct tooling-blocked signal
route-driver.sh surfaces that signal separately from FAIL
Add .agro/evals/probes/audit-tooling-blocked-signal.sh asserting the path exists
Probe exits 0, and exits 1 under diff-confirmed injection

userStories.title: CHANGELOG
userStories.description: As a user, I want the contract change recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: One `### Changed` entry and one `### Added` entry under `## [Unreleased]`
Each is one imperative sentence of 250 characters or fewer linking #1088
changelog-entry-length.sh prints PASS

userStories.title: Acceptance and the pull request
userStories.description: As the operator, I want verified evidence and a promotable PR.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm typecheck exits 0 and pnpm test reports no new failure against cf35b316
bash .agro/skills/eval/run.sh shows no PASS-to-REGRESSION
A PR is open against mifunedev/agro:development carrying its evidence in the body per the new contract
/audit pr reports PR-AUDIT-PROMOTABLE
The PR is not merged
